message:
♦️ FLEX ULTIMATE V2.0.4 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)

Version 2.0.4 brings comprehensive timeline synchronization, dead-air removal in Retakes, working filler word cuts, and essential preset bugfixes.

♦️ Auto Cut & Multi-Track Timeline Sync
♦️ Intelligent Track Sync: Cutting silence now moves all unlocked tracks (titles, B-roll, music) along with your dialogue so your entire edit stays in sync.
♦️ External Audio & Proxy Fix: Auto Cut analyzes the actual timeline mix—including external mics, merged clips, proxies, and clip speeds.
♦️ Tail-Safe Cut Points: Cut points land strictly inside gaps without clipping word endings.
♦️ Clean Link Handling: Unlinked audio stays unlinked, memory usage is halved, temporary files auto-purge, and waveforms stay sharp at all zoom levels.
♦️ Error Fix: Fixed the "flexBackupThen is not defined" crash.

♦️ Retakes & Filler Words
♦️ Dead-Air Removal: Retake cuts now extend through the pause between a stumble and a restart.
♦️ True Filler Word Removal: Cleanly deletes filler words from the timeline with accurate count reporting.

♦️ AutoCamera & Presets
♦️ Reliable Angle Switching: AutoCamera waits for cuts to complete before switching shots.
♦️ Adjustment Layers & Effects: Generates true Premiere adjustment layers and fixes "getVideoTrack is not a function" preset errors.
